sources.snippet: Dermoscopic skin-lesion classifier trained on ISIC 2019 (7 classes shared with HAM10000), with an ensemble of EfficientNetV2-S + CBAM and ConvNeXt-Tiny, a clinically calibrated operating point for melanoma, and external validation on PH2.

sources.title: Multi-Class Viral Skin Lesion Diagnosis Using ConvNeXt Deep Learning ...
sources.snippet: Multi-Class Viral Skin Lesion Diagnosis Using ConvNeXt Deep Learning with Explainable AI Abstract: The global burden of viral skin diseases including Monkeypox, Chickenpox, Cowpox, Measles, and Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) requires accurate diagnostic solutions.

sources.title: adeel-iqbal/skin-lesion-analyzer - GitHub
sources.snippet: 🩺 SkinAI — Skin Lesion Analyzer A skin lesion analysis tool built with a fine-tuned EfficientNetB0 model and a multi-agent AI pipeline. Explains results in plain language, assesses urgency, suggests next steps, finds nearby dermatologists with contacts and directions, and generates a downloadable PDF report in English, Urdu, or Arabic.

sources.title: A novel hybrid ConvNeXt-based approach for enhanced skin lesion ...
sources.snippet: This work presents a fresh MetaFormer-based CAFormer model that efficiently combines ConvNeXt blocks for precise skin cancer classification. The proposed model solves data imbalance and delivers state-of- the-art performance on the HAM10000 and ISIC 2019 datasets by efficiently merging convolutional and transformer architectures.

sources.title: Eraly-ml/Skin-AI · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MedConvNeXt is a deep learning model based on ConvNeXt, optimized for skin disease classification using PyTorch Lightning. The model leverages hyperparameter tuning via Optuna to enhance its performance over multiple training iterations.
